info.name: LLM Gateway API
info.description:
Requests, automated checks, and saved example responses for the LLM gateway: the OpenAI-compatible inference API used by the RAG backend (chat completions, task resolution and limits), the machine registration API used by services/local-llm, and the admin API behind the dashboard (providers, models, task list, routing, analytics).

Setup:
1. In services/llm-gateway run `docker compose --profile demo up --build` (the `demo` profile adds a fake OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible provider, so no real API keys are needed) and wait until Readiness returns 200.
2. Set the `apiKey` collection variable to LLM_GATEWAY_API_KEY, `registrationKey` to LLM_GATEWAY_REGISTRATION_API_KEY, and `adminPassword` to the admin password whose hash is in LLM_GATEWAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH.
3. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, in order. It logs in, removes leftovers from earlier runs, creates three demo providers (one per upstream protocol), models with limits and capabilities, routes for the built-in tasks and a default model, registers a local deployment the way services/local-llm does, sends streaming and non-streaming requests through each, checks the dashboard analytics, exercises error cases, and cleans up. Tasks are a fixed built-in list, so the demos replace the routes of built-in tasks: use a demo stack, not a gateway whose routes you want to keep.

Admin requests rely on Postman's cookie jar (the login cookie is sent automatically to {{baseUrl}}/admin/api). Example responses were captured from a live run against the fake provider.

item.name: 2. Admin - Session
item.description: Single admin from LLM_GATEWAY_ADMIN_USERNAME / LLM_GATEWAY_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH. Login sets an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie scoped to /admin/api that Postman's cookie jar sends automatically. Every POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE needs `X-Requested-With: llm-gateway-dashboard` (CSRF guard).

request.description: Without the session cookie every admin endpoint returns 401.
Mutations without `X-Requested-With: llm-gateway-dashboard` are rejected, which blocks cross-site form posts.
Wrong username or password. After 5 failures per minute the endpoint answers 429.

pm.test("Sets an HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookie", () => { const cookie = pm.response.headers.get("Set-Cookie"); pm.expect(cookie).to.include("HttpOnly"); pm.expect(cookie).to.include("SameSite=strict"); });
